_readme: What the app reads after it has shipped: src/remote-config.js. Everything here is optional; an empty file means the app behaves exactly as built. Switch names the app honours: install, cosmetics, voice. A notice needs an id, text in at least one language and an until date (YYYY-MM-DD, the last day it shows; test/remote-config.test.js refuses a notice without one); url must be https; minVersion/maxVersion are optional bounds on the app version it is meant for. Copies older than the until field ignore it, so take a notice out of this file once its date has passed.
